description: Screen 1-100 crypto wallet addresses against OFAC sanctions lists (SDN by default). Returns exact matches with sanctioned-entity details, address validation, a proceed-or-review decision and signed provenance. Optional: PDF/DOCX report (output_format) and, for a single EVM address, indirect exposure through counterparties (exposure_depth).

address.description: One wallet address to screen. Use this or addresses.

addresses.description: 1-100 wallet addresses to screen in one call. Use this or address.

asset.description: Optional asset or network ticker filter such as ETH, USDC, XBT, TRX, ARB, or BSC.

case_reference.description: Optional case reference to file the saved result under.

chains.description: EVM chain IDs to examine for indirect exposure (default ["1"], Ethereum).

exposure_depth.description: Single EVM address only: also check indirect exposure (1 = direct counterparties, 2 = their counterparties). Adds to the price.

lists.description: Sanctions lists to screen against. Defaults to ["ofac_sdn"]; add "ofac_consolidated" for OFAC's non-SDN lists.

lookback_days.description: Days of transfer history to examine for indirect exposure (default 180).

min_amount_usd.description: Ignore transfers below this USD value when checking indirect exposure. Transfers without a known price are kept.

output_format.description: json (default) for the structured result, or pdf/docx to also get a generated report artifact (adds $0.05).

save.description: Keep this result in your account so it can be retrieved later with saved_results. Needs sign-in or an API key; off by default.

name: wallet_screen

outputSchema.description: Structured response object returned by the tool in structuredContent.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded artifact content to decode and save locally.

name.description: Suggested file name for the artifact.

type.description: Artifact document type such as pdf or docx.

artifact_summary.description: Delivery and rendering metadata for an inline generated artifact.

delivery.description: How to retrieve or save the generated artifact.

downloadUrl.description: Hosted download URL when one exists; null when the artifact is inline only.

documentType.description: Rendered artifact type such as pdf or docx.

fileName.description: Suggested file name for the generated artifact.

artifacts.description: Artifact rendering hints keyed by format.

data.description: Primary structured result payload for the tool.

error.description: Machine-readable error code or message when the tool fails.

output.description: Nested renderer output when a workflow bundles an artifact render.

anyOf.description: Report-shaped payload with summary, metrics, tables, or evidence.
Null when no saved report is available.

report.description: Report-shaped payload when available; null for status-only retrieval responses.

anyOf.description: Source route, dataset, or execution metadata for the result.
